narrative.overview: Asthra 26 embodies a luxury minimalist glassmorphic aesthetic set against an infinite obsidian expanse. Rather than utilizing heavy opaque cards or extruded clay neumorphism with dual opposing drop shadows, every card, modal, and interactive container functions as a crystalline, semi-translucent glass prism suspended over velvet darkness. Surfaces breathe through a combination of optical backdrop blur (16px to 24px), ultra-fine metallic gold borders (1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.18)), and subtle top-edge specular illumination.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent Glass Architecture: Semi-transparent frosted obsidian surfaces (rgba(18, 18, 27, 0.65)) with hardware-accelerated blur.
Micro-Gold Accents: Hairline borders and specular edge reflections in warm champagne and Aztec gold.
Typography Distinction: The dramatic Roman serif grandeur of Cinzel paired with the clean, utilitarian geometry of Plus Jakarta Sans.
Atmospheric Depth: Diffuse, soft ambient halos and glows replacing heavy drop shadows.

rules.name: The Golden Rarity Rule
rules.body: Metallic gold gradient fills appear on at most one primary CTA button per view or modal. Auxiliary actions must remain glass-tinted with gold borders to preserve the value of the primary action.

rules.name: The Translucency Depth Rule
rules.body: Never use solid #12121b or fully opaque backgrounds for cards or popovers. Surfaces must use alpha transparency (rgba(18, 18, 27, 0.65)) with backdrop-filter: blur(16px) to allow underlying illumination and gradients to bleed through organically.

rules.name: The Regal Display Rule
rules.body: All Cinzel titles (.font-display) must be styled with letter-spacing of at least 0.03em and paired with gold clipping or glowing ambient drop-shadow.

rules.name: The No-Clay Rule
rules.body: Never apply heavy dual light/dark embossing or bevels. Surfaces must look like optical smoked glass, not carved clay.

rules.name: The Specular Edge Rule
rules.body: Every glass container must feature a hairline top specular highlight (inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) simulating light hitting a polished chamfered bevel.

dos: Do use backdrop-filter: blur(16px) on all floating cards, modals, and tooltips.
Do combine rgba(18, 18, 27, 0.65) with an inner specular highlight (inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)).
Do use the official title Asthra 26 and preserve Cinzel for display moments.
Do reserve the solid gold gradient button for the single primary conversion action per screen.
Do maintain isolated routes: clean event gallery on /, gatekeeping desk on /volunteer.
donts: Don't use opaque solid black or gray backgrounds (#12121b, #222) for cards that block backdrop translucency.
Don't use dual-axis clay neumorphic embossing shadows (8px 8px 18px ... -8px -8px 18px).
Don't use loud neon or generic saturated colors (plain #0000FF or #00FF00); stick to tailored gold, emerald green, and crimson.
Don't clutter the participant landing page with volunteer or administrative controls.
